name: dicom-rt
description: DICOM and radiotherapy domain knowledge — patient coordinates and slice geometry, RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/RTPLAN and rigid/deformable registration objects, DIMSE networking, synthetic test data and data-safety rules, and dose summation / EQD2 math; includes the dicom-guard hook that blocks DICOM files outside the synthetic test-data folder. Depends on `core`.
